Oxide / element conversion for XRF

Source: R/process.R
gc_oxide_to_element.Rd

gc_oxide_to_element() rewrites oxide rows (SiO2, Al2O3, ...) as their element (Si, Al, ...) using the mass factors in gc_oxides; gc_element_to_oxide() does the reverse for elements that have a conventional oxide. Units are unchanged (a wt% oxide gives a wt% element).

Usage

gc_oxide_to_element(ds, keep = FALSE)

gc_element_to_oxide(ds, keep = FALSE)

Arguments

ds

A gc_data object.

keep

Keep the original rows as well (default FALSE: replace).

Value

ds.

Examples

gc_measurements(gc_oxide_to_element(gc_example), "XRF")
